metadata.name: CIS Google Chrome Benchmark baseline
metadata.target: Windows Google Chrome enterprise policy registry
metadata.description: Practical control set used by this repository to demonstrate Chrome security benchmark auditing and hardening.
notes: Validate all settings against the official CIS Benchmark and local business requirements before production use.
Some controls are marked highImpact because they may affect user workflows.

controls.title: Require Safe Browsing protection
controls.rationale: Safe Browsing helps block known phishing, malware, and dangerous downloads.
controls.remediation: Set SafeBrowsingProtectionLevel to 1 for standard protection or 2 for enhanced protection.

controls.title: Restrict dangerous downloads
controls.rationale: Download restrictions reduce exposure to malware and unsafe files.

controls.title: Disable built-in password manager
controls.rationale: Centralized enterprise password management is easier to govern and audit than unmanaged browser storage.
controls.remediation: Set PasswordManagerEnabled to 0 when an approved password manager is available.

controls.title: Disable address autofill
controls.rationale: Disabling unmanaged autofill reduces accidental disclosure of personal information.

controls.title: Disable credit card autofill
controls.rationale: Disabling payment autofill helps reduce payment data exposure on shared or managed endpoints.

controls.title: Block unmanaged extension installation by default
controls.rationale: Browser extensions can read pages, intercept data, and expand the endpoint attack surface.
controls.remediation: Block all extensions by default, then manage approved extensions through an allowlist.

controls.title: Block geolocation by default
controls.rationale: Default-deny geolocation reduces unnecessary location disclosure.

controls.title: Block notifications by default
controls.rationale: Blocking default notifications reduces social engineering and unwanted prompts.

controls.title: Block popups by default
controls.rationale: Popup blocking reduces unwanted redirects, abusive prompts, and drive-by risk.

controls.title: Disable third-party cookies
controls.rationale: Third-party cookie blocking improves privacy posture and limits cross-site tracking.

controls.title: Disable browser guest mode
controls.rationale: Guest mode can bypass managed profile controls and reduce traceability.

controls.title: Disable QUIC protocol when inspection is required
controls.rationale: Disabling QUIC may be required in environments that rely on network inspection and consistent proxy enforcement.
controls.remediation: Set QuicAllowed to 0 if organizational inspection requirements apply.
